target.name: Tortoise North American Energy Independence Fund

announcement.quote: Purpose of the filing: The Board of Trustees has approved the reorganization of the Tortoise North American Energy Independence Fund into the Tortoise Select Opportunity Fund.

deals.notes: Both are series of Managed Portfolio Series (CIK 1511699 is the trust). Listing status and outcome are not stated in the excerpts; the agreement is proposed to be effective May 8, 2017.

problems: The CIK is a fund trust, so episode_role is 'other'. An N-14 filed 2018-05-31 and amended 2018-08-02 proposes reorganizing Target Olstein Funds (Olstein Trust) and an earlier set of Target Funds into series of the trust, but the excerpts name no specific funds, so no deals are recorded for them. The 2017 and 2018 proxy statements are about advisory agreements, not mergers.
